scope: Visual preproduction only. All combat statistics, timelines and recruitment rules are design targets rather than implemented or playtested systems.

art_direction.originality: Original dark-fairytale world; references inform readability and craft, not copied characters, compositions or proprietary sprites.
art_direction.mood: Warm humanity inside a worn, rain-dark fantasy; moral ambiguity becomes readable through faces and gestures.
art_direction.pixel_rules: Native 32px tiles, 64px actor cells, hard pixel clusters, nearest-neighbour presentation, no antialiased diagonals or painted blur; texture uses 2–4px clusters, no salt-and-pepper noise.
art_direction.readability: Terrain low contrast; units stronger values; faces and class tools highest contrast. Ally cyan rails, hostile red broken chevrons, neutral white cloth and open hands.

class_icons.Healer: Mint cross formed from four diamond pips.

animation_contract.status: Preproduction specifications only. No runtime or production-ready animation claims.
animation_contract.perspective: Three-quarter top-down, orthographic. South-east is the hero concept view.

base_sprite.outline: 1px coal, light-facing edge hue shifted; no black rectangle background

animation_contract.directional_rule: Eight authored directions. Mirroring is allowed for early blockout only; hand/weapon asymmetry must be corrected before production.
animation_contract.sheet_layout: One action per sheet, columns=ordered animation frames; rows=the eight directions in the declared order. Cells64x64, 2px extruded gutter only at final atlas packaging. Name actor_id/action/direction/frame_001.

large_actor.rule: Keep boss attacks in separate160/320px VFX canvases; do not enlarge ordinary64px character cells.

animation_contract.portrait_crop: Head, shoulders, recognisable tool/weapon edge; eye line y35; face readable at48px. Separate still portrait from animation sheets.

idle.motion: One-pixel breath across four poses; planted foot fixed; equipment lags one frame.

walk.motion: Contacts 1/4, passing poses 3/6; one-pixel vertical bob; small opposed arm arc.

run.motion: Contacts 1/5, airborne 3/7; lean three pixels; two-pixel bob; dust only on contact.

basic_attack.motion: Attack-specific silhouette; release/contact frame4; no hit before readable windup.

ability_a.motion: Distinct class-shaped anticipatory glyph; release frame 4; body and VFX separate; enemy/boss long windup uses stretched tell frames.

ability_b.motion: Distinct class-shaped anticipatory glyph; release frame 4; body and VFX separate; enemy/boss long windup uses stretched tell frames.

hit.motion: One-pixel recoil, warm rim then return; avoid sustained flicker.

downed.motion: Weapon drops away from silhouette; kneel to side-lie; static breathing end pose with rescue icon.

surrender.motion: Lower weapon, open both hands, raise parchment cloth, settle; endpoint loops breathing.

noncombatant.motion: Bundle or child-sized companion silhouette; open hands; no combat equipment or target ring.

portrait.motion: Optional blink and tiny shoulder breath only; first frame is the static recruitment snapshot.

celebrate.motion: Personal gesture, not a shared weapon lift; used only after safe wave completion.

animation_contract.foot_contacts: Walk contacts 1/4, passing 3/6; run contacts 1/5, airborne 3/7. Root motion is not painted into frames. Fixed pivot (32,56); contact toe at baseline. Test later at 60/80px per second.

vfx_contract.body_separation: Export body, weapon, contact flash, projectile, ground circle and decal separately. Do not bake health bars, targeting circles or text into sprites.
vfx_contract.maximum_flash: Peak contact flash2frames; no strobe sequences; reduced-motion treatment replaces shake with2px border pulse.

shape_grammar.heal: Mint cross formed from four diamond pips.
shape_grammar.strategy: Amber hexagonal trap marker and dotted trace.
shape_grammar.hostile: Hollow red chevron with pale broken edge.
shape_grammar.safe: Filled pale center with open outer ring.

export_contract.sprite_png: RGBA sRGB, nearest-neighbour, unpremultiplied alpha,1x native scale plus optional4x presentation copy
export_contract.review: Generated art contact sheets are design references until every frame/cell/direction is reviewed and separated. No automatic spritesheet quality claim.

animation_contract.enemy_timing_override: Roster animation frames are the base clip contract. Enemy/boss ability windup and recovery durations are deliberate overrides: hold the anticipation and recovery poses without moving the active event off frame 4. Attack interval includes idle time after recovery.

beats: A misplaced order sends a novice commander to Hinge Gate.
Choose one recruitment district: Bar (6), Kingdom (15), or Village (10). Each district introduces all available adults with portrait, name, class and two abilities.
Select exactly two initial allies; inspect without time pressure, place defenses, and learn Guard/Patrol/Advance.
storyboard.visual_keyframe: Two mismatched allies before an oversized broken standard; warm sunrise offers hope.

beats: Large waves of weak mobs test route coverage.
Weapons lowered and open palms identify some nonattackers; wounded couriers carry letters.
A winning defense triggers a surrender offer. The negotiation scene pauses combat; player can accept, decline or seek guarantees.
storyboard.visual_keyframe: A Bellbone lays down a bell while hostile silhouettes continue on a separate lane.

beats: Two rescue beacons and a major siege force allocation decisions.
Victory opens introductions for all five monster generals; choose exactly two as allies.
Defeat does not recruit generals; survivors retreat and casualties are acknowledged without gore.
storyboard.visual_keyframe: Five monster banners lower beneath the aqueduct while two rescue lights blink beyond the breach.

beats: Return to the crossroads; Royal Capital (10 candidates) and Prison (12) open in addition to early districts.

Assumption resolving ambiguous original rule: choose five newcomers after defeat or with zero to one surviving original ally; choose three after victory with both original allies. Existing recruits and earned generals remain; no duplicate recruitment.
The recovery battle is optional, with no permanent-loss soft lock. Short camp conversations reflect alliances and grievances.
storyboard.visual_keyframe: Capital carriage and prison door face one another across a warm camp lantern.

beats: Surviving allies and newcomers defend the courtyard and enter Avarren’s threshold.
Three readable boss phases expose the crown and oath anchors.

After combat, choose forgive or refuse pardon. Pardon breaks the crown voluntarily and opens a shared road; refusal seals the crown and begins a public reckoning. Neither choice is treated as a joke or selected on a timer.
An illustrated epilogue shows the actual survivors, rescued civilians and remembered choices, then a procedural title.
storyboard.visual_keyframe: The crown rests between outstretched hands; surviving companions frame both possible decisions.

recruitment_locations.name: The Bent Lantern
recruitment_locations.art: Warm crowded timber bar, six personal stools/tools establish every recruit silhouette; rough clothing, adult ages and body types varied.

recruitment_locations.name: The Crownward Yard
recruitment_locations.art: Three five-person training groups in pale stone cloisters; polished equipment with visible repairs, no interchangeable identical helmets.
recruitment_locations.intro_camera: Wide courtyard to banner grouping, then individual portrait.

recruitment_locations.name: Reedwake Common
recruitment_locations.art: Two five-person groups around communal well and harvest carts; practical layered clothes, improvised well-kept tools. Poverty affects access and story, not inherent worth/stat budget.
recruitment_locations.intro_camera: Low well foreground frames two groups; pick person without moving portrait layout.

recruitment_locations.name: Glassmarket Contracts
recruitment_locations.art: Two five-person contract tables beneath copper awnings; cosmopolitan mercenaries, royal couriers and veterans, varied skin tones and builds.
recruitment_locations.intro_camera: Market panorama to contract desk then portrait.

recruitment_locations.name: The Quiet Cells
recruitment_locations.art: Three four-person groups in a daylit stone hall with open doors; blankets, letters and personal objects; dignified varied adults, no torture spectacle.
recruitment_locations.intro_camera: Outside bars to open hall; portrait uses the same respectful scale as noble recruits.

towers.name: Palisade Roost
towers.silhouette: Low square timber base, peaked shield roof, visible shooter window.
upgrade_stages: I: Four posts and cloth roof.
II: Copper braces and wider window.
III: Shield slats and two lanterns.
towers.draft_effect: One ranged occupant receives 25% reduction to incoming projectile damage; its ranged basic-attack accuracy is 85%, compared with 100% on the ground. Range, damage and attack interval remain unchanged. No healing or trap bonuses. Unit remains visibly inside; cover does not reduce melee or area damage.

towers.name: Waybell Beacon
towers.silhouette: Slender bellpost inside a diamond stone plinth, open center.
upgrade_stages: II: Two bells and teal ribbon.
towers.draft_effect: Highlights at most six flying enemies within four tiles and reveals the next branch. Upgrade radii are four/five/six tiles; target cap stays six. No damage bonus.

towers.name: Hearthward
towers.silhouette: Round low brazier with cross-shaped stone rim, soft leaf smoke.
upgrade_stages: II: Two pots and bandage shelf.
towers.draft_effect: Heals one ally at 8 HP/s between waves or 4 HP/s during combat, with a finite 60 HP healing reserve per wave. No overhealing; multiple Hearthwards cannot heal the same ally simultaneously. Clearly different from Healer unit casts.

towers.name: Bolt Cradle
towers.silhouette: Wide copper-and-timber crossbow on squat stepped base.
upgrade_stages: III: Twin limbs with one projectile barrel.
towers.draft_effect: One nonpiercing bolt deals 18 damage to one target every 2s; range four tiles, minimum range 1.5. Slow visible flight, fixed firing arc and cost distinguish it from DPS units.

traps.name: Snare Stitch
traps.silhouette: Six amber corners and a hexagonal center.
traps.draft_effect: Four damage and 25% slow for 2s to the first eligible enemy crossing; one target and one charge. Slow does not stack with itself. Never hide the ground target.

traps.name: Cinder Pot
traps.silhouette: Round amber pot inside a chevron frame.
traps.draft_effect: 12 damage to at most four enemies in a one-tile radius, maximum 48 total damage per pot. One trigger after a 0.8s visible fuse; no ally damage; fire outline remains clear over all terrain.

traps.name: Decoy Standard
traps.silhouette: Parchment forked banner with an obvious hollow body.
traps.draft_effect: Taunts at most three light mobs for 1.5s within two tiles; does not affect bosses; one use. Reapplication does not extend the taunt.

deployment_modes.Guard: Square foot bracket and one fixed anchor; turn toward target while feet stay planted.
deployment_modes.Patrol: Rounded cyan waypoint loop and dashed double-rail route; upper-body attack animates over walk/run lower body; projectile release remains a fixed frame.
deployment_modes.Advance: Three forward chevrons and target flag; walk toward hostile, then respect engagement range; avoid an unreadable charge.
deployment_modes.mobility_attack_rule: Separate upper/lower body animation layers during production; contact foot never flips mid-stride; rooted casts use a telegraphed brief stop.

ui.gameplay_hud: Top-left gate HP and wave; top-center act title and time; top-right pause and sync; bottom six-to-eight unit cards with class shape, HP and two ability cooldown wedges. Selected unit expands to show exact cooldown seconds. Presentation uses 2x nearest-neighbour scale.

order: Name · Age · class icon and label
HP / basic damage / attack interval / range / movement
Ability A name, effect, cooldown, 64px VFX thumbnail
Ability B name, effect, cooldown, 64px VFX thumbnail
recruitment_card.comparison: Two pins allow side-by-side comparison. No hidden power score or social-class tier. Draft balance notice appears in this art bible, not final product UI.

ui.pause: Frozen battlefield with dark navy scrim; Resume, Roster, Route edit, Settings, Save/Exit. Show pending editor changes as a count and do not silently apply them.
ui.extension_popup: Compact 360×540 concept: connected-pair badge, current map thumbnail, selected object controls, Undo/Redo, and Open Full Editor button. Actual browser popup size remains within browser constraints.
ui.detached_editor: 1280×800 concept: 64px left tool rail, central map canvas, right 280px properties panel, bottom history and connection status. Tools: select, tower, unit, track, trap, erase. Native pixel preview at 1x/2x/4x.
drag_and_drop_states: Rest: palette ghost has a clear pickup handle.
Pickup: 4px shadow and original slot outline.
Drag: ground-foot ghost follows cursor; range and collision footprint shown.
Valid: teal corner brackets and snapped tile coordinates.
Invalid: hatched footprint, lock icon and reason such as Track blocked.
Drop: 80ms settle with one contact dust puff.
Cancel: return to origin without cost.
Undo/redo: ghost replays last placement with count and label.
ui.undo_redo: Two explicit toolbar buttons andCtrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Zlegend;history shows object name and proposed/reverted state, never exposes internal protocols.
ui.synchronization: Game remains authoritative: Synced check badge, Pending outlined clock, Conflict split diamond with Review changes, Disconnected broken chain. Conflict compare shows PC state and proposed edit, with Apply/Discard only when safe. During combat, queue edits until a safe phase.

session_warning.title: Multiple Game Instances Detected
session_warning.body: Your game is currently active on another device or platform. Only one active PC gameplay session and one connected editor session are permitted.
session_warning.detail: One PC plus its authorized editor is a single connected pair. Show reconnect state after expiring heartbeat; UI must not imply a permanent lock after crash.

ui.accessibility: Shape, text and color coding; readable 4.5:1 body contrast; minimum 16px HUD text at presentation resolution; independent VFX intensity and camera-shake toggles; nonflashing cooldowns; paused recruitment and decision timers.

endings.forgive: Crown placed in open hands; teal roots unwind into warm gold leaves; generals and humans share the road. Reconstruction accompanies accountability.
endings.refuse_pardon: Crown sealed in parchment and copper chest; root light settles; companions escort Avarren to a public hearing or banishment based on prior choices. Somber dawn, no gory execution.
endings.survivors: Epilogue frames only feature actual survivors; empty places hold their tools and names.

titles.design: Combinatorial epithet plus deed plus legacy; one thousand candidate combinations rather than one thousand handmade art cards.
titles.additional_variant: Pardon/refusal, roster and dialogue seal variants can increase the count; unique valid titles require an editorial deduplication pass.
titles.visual: One shared parchment title card with modular class/location/mercy seals; legible text is never generated inside animation frames.
titles.count_explanation: 10 epithets × 10 deeds × 10 legacies × 2 ending verses = 2,000 full title-card combinations. There are 1,000 base title phrases; editorial filtering is still needed for meaningful combinations.

assumptions: All recruitable humanoid characters are adults; diverse ages and bodies without child-soldier depictions.
The barbarian bar is rough and diverse, avoiding ethnic caricature.
Village recruits use equal class budgets to trained nobles; differences are kit, training, story and tradeoffs.
Act IV chooses five newcomers after loss or with at most one surviving original ally; otherwise three after a win with both original allies. Earned generals stay.
A 30-minute run is pacing intent, not a benchmarked length.
Mercenary contracts require gold; cost cannot lock out the minimum functional recovery roster.
Generals may fight under hostile banners before joining; nonhostility uses explicit state badges rather than species color.

balance_constraints.status: Proposed finite target caps for later implementation/playtesting.
balance_constraints.selection: Nearest eligible targets first; healing uses lowest percentage HP first. Stable actor ID resolves ties. All per-cast caps count distinct actors, so re-entry cannot multiply a capped effect.
balance_constraints.stacking: Repeated copies of the same slow, evasion buff, redirection or taunt do not stack or extend one another; the strongest eligible effect applies.
balance_constraints.trap_limits: One placed trap per tile, at most three live allied traps per placing Strategist and twelve allied traps total. More restrictive per-ability limits still apply. Every consumed or replaced trap has a visible spent/fade state.
